tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras ser po zhi ba bde byed sgrub cing mchod pa'i las rim dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras ser po zhi ba bde byed sgrub cing mchod pa'i las rim dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras ser po zhi ba bde byed sgrub cing mchod pa'i las rim dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras ser po zhi ba bde byed sgrub cing mchod pa'i las rim zangs dkar gyi lugs su bkod pa dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi dag pa'i sa mchog mi g.yo bar// bzhugs kyang drang srong rnam mang thos zhes bya'i// sras su tshul bstan gnod sbyin kun rgyal por// dbang bskur byang phyogs gnas bzhugs de la 'dud// 'di'i dbang thob cing dam la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas 'di sgrub pa'i tshe/ rta bong gi sha dang yug mos byin pa'i zas mi za/ snod gas chag can du bza' btung spangs/ mi rta'i ro la mi 'ju/ re nag gi gos gdan la mi spyod/ lung thang gi phreng ba bsgrang*/ stod g.yogs sngon po 'chang ba ste khyad par gyi dam tshig bdun la gnas shing*/ phyi rten rta sngon po 'chang*/ nang rten bris sku mtshan nyid ldan pa bkram/ gsang rten mtshan sngags bcas pa'i ga'u man ngag las 'byung ba ltar bca' ba ste/ rten gsum btsugs pa la gnas yid dang mthun par lha rdzas kyi bla bre dang yol 'phen rin po che sna tshogs pas mdzes par byas pa'i khang pa bzang por/ zhag kha shas sgrub pa yin na rin po che'i snod gas chag med pa'i nang du khang brtsegs thog gsum rgya phibs can gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du khang bzang thog re ba brgyad dang*/ de'i phyi 'khor sa rim pa gsum ldan bkod pa sogs mdun bskyed ltar legs pa bca'/ nyin sgrub lta bu'i tshe ni mchod gtor la brten pa yang rung*/ khang bzang de nyid rgyal chen gyi bris sku'i mdun bsham/ gzhan yang mchod gtor dkar zlum che ba la 'khor brgyad kyis bskor ba rgyan can bza' btung sna tshogs pa/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo bdag bskyed kyi mchod gtor sogs bshams pa ni sngon du 'gro ba'i chos so// dngos gzhi la gnyis| bdag bskyed pa dang*/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa'o// dang po ni/

skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ chos skyong gzhi bdag bgegs la gtor ma cha gsum btang*/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo spyi ltar bsgom/ rang nyid skad cig gis phyag na rdo rje gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa las 'od 'phros gsang ba'i bdag po gos sngon can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ nī laṃ wā ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du shapada'i bar gyis mchod nas/ g.yon brkyang brjid pa'i gar stabs kyis// ri bong 'dzin pa'i gdan la 'gyings| |klu rigs gdug pa'i dgrar gyur pa// khro rgyal khyod la spyi bos 'dud// ces bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ tshogs zhing rang la bstim/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang rig hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer 'bar ba'i 'od kyis 'gro ba rnams sbyangs/ 'phags pa rnams mchod/ thams cad dpal ldan gos sngon can gyi sku'i ngo bor byas te hūm̐ la bsdus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'bar bar gyur/ de las rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po sku mdog sngon po cher 'bar ba shin tu khros shing dregs pa/ klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnun pa'i tshul 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdig mdzub bsgrengs pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ spyan gsum dmar zhing mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing log 'dren thams cad sreg pa'i me 'od 'phro ba/ ha ha'i gad rgyangs cher sgrog pas gdug pa can thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ dar sngon po'i bla gos dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/

zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyis bzhugs pa/ zhes dang*/ stag pa jo bzang nas brgyud pa'i phyag rdor mdo lugs su grags pa chos skyong sbrel ba'i zab khyad lag len byed na/ seng ge'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs can/ klu chen po brgyad zhabs kyis mnan pa'i mjug ma phrin las khyung chen po'i zhal du gsol ba/ zhes gong mar sbyar ro// de ltar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ gong bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ gnas gsum du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po'i 'od kyis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs thams cad bsdus shing byin gyis brlabs/ rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyen du 'khyil ba mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer spro ba dang bsdu bas las thams cad 'grub par dmigs la/ oṃ nī laṃ wā ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa 'bum phrag bcu gsum bzlas na las thams cad 'grub par gsungs so// thun mtshams su mchod bstod bya/ a kā ros gtor ma 'bul/ gong gi stag pa jo bzang lugs byed na/ bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ nī laṃ wā ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ra dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes pa'o// gnyis pa mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ rang phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po'i 'od kyis lcang lo can nas rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis mchod pa rnams bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin rlabs/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wā ra prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bsang gtor byas nas/

slar| ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ ngal bsos dge ba stobs po che// sbom zhing 'phrog byed gdan la bzhugs// phyag mtshan rgyal mtshan ne'u le bsnams// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'dud| |lha mi'i dpal yon du mas mchod// nongs pa gang mchis de ring bshags// dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang*// bla med chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// rtag tu mi bsnyel mi gtong shog /ces bstod/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi yi ge las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la phog pas 'od du zhu zhing stong pa chen po gyur pa'i ngang las/ mdun du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i sa gzhi gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i dbus su bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa dgu las| dbus kyi pho brang sum brtsegs kyi rtse mor nyi zla nor bu'i tog gis mdzes pa/ gter gyi khang pa bco lnga yod pa/ rin po che'i dra ba dra phyed la sogs pa rgyan du mas spras pa/ shar shel/ lho bai ḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga /byang gser las grub pa ka ba nyis stong lnga brgyas bteg pa/ 'khor sa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'dod 'jo'i ba dang*/ bum pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ rin po che'i ri bo/ rdzing bu bzang po rnams brgyad brgyad spel mar yod pa'i phyi rol du rin po che'i ra ba gru bzhi pas bskor ba/ pho brang dbus ma'i nang du hrīḥdamar po las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du bai ser po 'od 'bar ba rgyal mtshan bais mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ 'jig rten gyi dbul phong thams cad bsal/ dpal phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus shing de la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal po chen po ngal bsos po gser gyi lhun po ltar 'tsher zhing brjid pa/ phyag g.yas rin po che'i rgyal mtshan nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i tog gis spras pa nu ma g.yas pa'i thad du 'dzin cing*/

g.yon rin po che sna tshogs pa skyug pa'i ne'u le dku g.yon du brten pa/ dbu la rin po che'i prog zhu gsol zhing*/ zhal nas rin po che mtha' yas pa'i char 'bebs pa/ gser gyi ya klad dang dar dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ nyi zla 'od zer rab tu 'bar bas phrag gong brgyan pa/ nyi zla bye ba'i gzi brjid la 'gong ba'i 'od zer 'bar ba nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes shing*/ dbul phongs las skyob pa'i thugs brtse dang ldan pa'i phrin las la dbang phyug pa/ 'phrog byed rab tu dregs pa bde bar nyal ba gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i steng na g.yas brkyang gi skyil krung gis 'gyings pa/ zhes gtso bo dang*/ sgrub pa yun ring po do gal che ba'i dus skabs su nang 'khor bskyed pa ni/ de'i sta zur g.yon du btsun mo me tog gtsug phud ma dmar mo sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ka can/ phyag gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa rin po ches mtshan pa bsnams shing*/ rin po che pad+ma'i phreng ba'i rgyan can shin tu mdzes pa'i 'od kyis snang ba dbang du sdud cing smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba/ gtso bo'i mdun du sras gar mkhan mchog zhal bzhi g.yas dang rgyab sngo ba/ g.yon dkar rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dmar po khro 'dzum can| phyag g.yas pa brgyad rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che pad+ma ral gri zhags pa mda' dgra sta/ g.yon pa brgyad dril bu rtse gsum ne'u le me tog phur ma ba dan tho ba gzhu rnga yab rnams thogs pa| rin po che dang me tog gis brgyan pa sbrul dang dar dang stag gi sham thabs sogs zhi khro 'chol ba'i rgyan can/ g.yas su gnod gnas ser po bi dza pū ra ka dang ne'u le 'dzin pa sbom zhing 'gyings pa/ rin po che dang ut+pa la'i rgyan can dung dang pad+ma'i steng na bzhugs pa/ rgyab tu rmugs 'dzin 'chol ba nag po thod khrag dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ gcer bu klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa rigs ngan rna ba ma phug pa nor bdag gi steng na brkyang bskum gyis gnas pa/

g.yon du rgyal ba khyu mchog sngo ljang rin po ches gang ba'i snod dang ne'u le 'dzin pa gzhon mdzes spen pa'i cha lugs can/ shar lhor sras mchog kun tu rgyal ba mis drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas pa dbyug pa dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu bskyed pa po/ nub byang du gdon po che/ byang shar du bum pa'i lto can bzhi rin po che dang ne'u le 'dzin pa rnams las mthun gyi kha dog can/ de dag gi mtha' skor du thun mong gi sras dgu bcu rtsa gcig po yang khro zhing brjid pa/ sku mdog dang rgyan phyag mtshan sna tshogs pas yongs su bskor bar gyur/ ces nang 'khor 'di rnams gal ma che na sbyar mi rung bas skabs don shes pa gal che'o// pho brang bar pa na phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang*/ gong ma na bla ma brgyud pa rnams bzhugs pa/ phyi'i shar gyi khang brtsegs su dzaṃ las dzaṃ bha la ser po g.yas rin po che/ lho'i khang par paṃ las gang ba bzang po ser po g.yas bum pa/ nub kyi khang par maṃ las nor bu bzang po dkar po g.yas nor bu rin po che/ byang gi khang par kaṃ las ku be ra mthing nag g.yas ral gri/ shar lho'i khang par saṃ las yang dag shes ser po g.yas gser gyi shang lang*/ lho nub kyi khang par gaṃ las 'brog gnas nag po g.yas mdung ring*/ nub byang gi khang par paṃ las lnga rtsen ser skya g.yas rin po che'i khang brtsegs/ byang shar gyi khang par paṃ las 'jam po 'khyil pa dkar po g.yas gri dang phub/ de rnams kyi g.yon thams cad nor bu du ma skyug pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ rab tu dpa' zhing brjid la rngam pa lha rdzas kyi go cha dang rin po che dang dar gyis spras pa/ myur mgyogs glog dang bskal pa'i rlung gi shugs dang ldan pa'i rta mchog rang rang gi kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o// phyi'i 'khor sa dang po la klu chen po brgyad gdengs ka rab tu rgyas pa yid bzhin nor bu'i cod pan can rin po che sna tshogs pas gang ba'i gzhong pa 'dzin pas gtso bo la 'dud pa/

sbrul mjug g.yas su 'khyil zhing mdzes pa rang rang gi 'khor du mas yongs su bskor ba/ 'khor sa bar pa rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i nang rim la shar du sde dpon ring po/ mig bzang*/ gang po/ ser skya dang bzhi/ lhor seng ge/ nye ba'i seng ge/ dung can/ dga' bo ste bzhi/ nub tu seng ge/ seng ge ral pa/ bla ma/ ser skya ste bzhi/ byang du 'dzin pa| 'dzin dga'/ brtson skyon/ khyab 'jug ste bzhi/ shar lhor tshig lnga ser po/ lho nub tu ri mnyam/ nub byang du gser can/ byang shar du lnga spyod rnams nor bu'i rigs/ slar yang shar na sa pa/ lhor shin tu sa pa/ nub tu nag po/ byang du nye nag bzhi glang po'i rigs/ byang shar du nyi ma/ shar lhor zla ba/ lho nub tu me/ nub byang du rlung ste ba glang gi rigs/ de ltar sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad po rnams kha dog dmar nag cung zad khros pa g.yas ral gri dang g.yon phub 'dzin pa/ phyi rim la shar du dbang po/ zla ba/ chu lha/ skye dgu'i bdag po/ brdol ba'i rgyal mtshan/ dbang ldan/ tsan+dan/ 'dod pa'i gtso bo ste brgyad/ lhor mgrin ngan/ mgul nges/ ba ḍi/ nor bu/ spyod pa/ sgra rab/ nyer lnga/ ri mnyam ste brgyad/ nub tu gser can/ gang po/ seng ldeng*/ g.yon phyogs lha/ ba lang skyong*/ 'brog gnas/ mi'i rgyal po/ rgyal ba khyu mchog ste brgyad/ byang na tshig lnga ser po/ bzhin bzang*/ ring po/ dri za sna tshogs sde/ 'bras bu gsum pa/ mgul pa gsum pa/ lcags mdung ring po/ lha las byung ba'i ma ldan ste brgyad/ de ltar stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis po kha dog ljang nag rin po che rnam pa bzhi'i go cha can g.yas mdung dang g.yon ral gri thogs pa/ gtum rngam sa ga'i rigs dmag dpon gyi tshul can rang rang gi 'khor g.yog du ma dang bcas pa'o// 'khor sa phyi ma la phyogs skyong bcu/ gza' chen brgyad/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad/ lha klu dri za gnod sbyin la sogs pa sde brgyad kyi dpung gi tshogs mang po dang*/

gnod sbyin gser gyi yan lag dang 'jigs byed sogs rdzong chen gnas pa bco lnga/ 'khor ba 'jig /skya nor bu/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa sogs yul 'khor skyong ba lnga brgya/ 'khor gnod sbyin bye ba phrag du ma'i tshogs rnams mtshon cha du ma tshogs pa 'phyar bas dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod cing*/ nor bu sna tshogs pa char 'bebs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pas sgrub po'i bsam pa yongs su tshim par byed pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings su char sprin dkrigs pa ltar bzhugs par bsam/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dmar po skar mda' lta bu 'phros pa'i sna la khro rgyal ṭak+ki rā dza dmar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa spros pas byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi khang bzang nas rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa thogs pa med par spyan drangs par bsam/ gu gul dkar po/ tsan+dan dkar po/ ga pur/ du ru ka /a ga ru rnams sbyar zhing ril bur byas pa'i spos bsregs la spos 'di sgrub mchod kyi dus dang spyan 'dren la ma gtogs dus min du bsreg na bar gcod du 'gyur zhes bla ma rnams gsungs so// rol mo du ma'i sgra dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ */ rdo rje 'chang dbang gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin// spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje la sogs pa// rtsa brgyud bla ma byin rlabs can rnams kyis// bdag sogs gsol 'debs rnams la brtser dgongs la// chos skyong dam la 'dogs shing gnas 'dir gshegs// gu ru rat+na sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs pas bla ma rnams byon nas pho brang gong mar bzhugs par bsam/ pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ slar/ hūm̐ */ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod// 'dzin mdzad lag na rdo rje 'dzin// gos sngon 'chang ba'i lha tshogs rnams// 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs su gsol// oṃ nī laṃ wā ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes spyan drangs pas gos sngon gyi lha tshogs skad cig la byon nas pho brang bar mar bzhugs par bsam/ slar/ mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan yang*// shākya seng ge'i spyan sngar khyod// thugs dam zhal bzhes de dgongs la// 'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la sman slad du/ byang phyogs na bzhugs rgyal po che// 'khor bcas brtse bas gnas 'dir byon// bai shra ma ṇa ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bai shra ma ṇa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes dang*/ bai sum cu rtsa gnyis brjod/ rgyal po chen po 'khor bcas rnams// bdag gi mdun du byon ma thag /sna tshogs rin chen dbu rgyan gsol// chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol lo// oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod/ rang gsang bdag tu gsal ba'i thugs ka nas khro bo'i tshogs spros pas phyi 'brang gi bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ oṃ nī laṃ sogs dang*/ 'khyil ba dang*/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du bstim/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos rgyas gdab pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ga'i rnam par bkug ste thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ ces brjod byin gyis brlabs/ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas dang*// rol mo la sogs lha yi rdzas// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul| |oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ rin chen gdugs mdzes gser nya dang*// gter gyi bum pa pad+ma dang*// dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dpal be'u// mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'khor lo sogs// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol slad du// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya sa pa ri wā ra aṣ+ṭa maṅga laṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/

gser gyi 'khor lo nor bu dbang gi rgyal// mdzes sdug btsun mo blo ldan blon po mchog /so ldan thal kar cang shes gzhon pa'i phul// rgol ba kun 'joms dmag dpon dang bcas pa// rgyal po khyod la 'os pa'i rin chen bdun| |rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la phul ba yis// 'phags pa'i nor bdun dag la spyod par shog /oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya sa pa ri wā ra sap+ta ma hā rat+na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ phyogs dus kun na gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dang*// dri bsung ro mngar reg bya 'jam pa yi// 'dod pa'i yon tan 'dod dgu sna tshogs pa// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la phul ba yis// ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba'i sku thob shog /oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye sa pa ri wā ra pañca kā ma gu ṇa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ rab ngos me long gi waṃ dang*// zho dang durba bilba'i 'bras// g.yas 'khyil dung dang li khri dmar// yungs kar dang bcas bkra shis pa'i// rdzas mchog ma lus ji snyed kun// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bkra shis bde legs dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya sa pa ri wā ra maṅga la dra bya aṣ+ṭa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ bsod nams stobs las grub pa 'dod 'jo'i ba| |dgos 'dod sna tshogs 'byung ba gter gyi bum// 'dod yon kun ldan dpag bsam ljon pa'i mchog /rin thang dpag yas rin chen ri dbang brjid// gdung sel yan lag brgyad ldan khrus kyi rdzing*// dgos 'byung ma rmos lo 'bras tshar du dngar// sna tshogs 'dod pa'i yon tan ji snyed pa// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la bdag 'bul na// dgyes bzhin bzhes nas bdag la dngos grub stsol// oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya sa pa ri wā ra sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ bstod pa bsdus pa ni/ rin chen pho brang dam pa ru/ */mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri steng na// bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni// ngal bsos dge ba stobs po che// g.yas na rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin// g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin// sku ni gser gyi 'od las mdzes| |zhal nas rin chen char pa 'bebs// thugs rjes phongs pa las sgrol mdzad// sku la rin chen rgyan mang spras// phrag gong g.yas g.yon nyi zlas mtshan// nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid 'bar// dbu la rin chen cod pan can// gnod sbyin bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor// nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa// gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// btsun mo sras dang gnod gnas dang*// rmugs 'dzin rgyal ba khyu mchog dang*// kun tu rgyal dang bskyed pa po// gdon po che dang bum lto can// nang 'khor rnams la bdag bstod do/

/dzaṃ bha la dang gang ba bzang*/ /nor bu bzang dang ku be ra/ /yang dag shes dang 'brog gnas dang*// lnga rtsen 'jam po 'khyil pa ste// rta bdag brgyad la bdag bstod do| |klu chen rab 'jigs rnam brgyad dang*// sde dpon nyer brgyad stobs chen ni// sum cu rtsa gnyis ljongs gnas pa// bco lnga yul 'khor skyong ba'i bdag /lnga brgya gnod sbyin bye ba sogs| |'khor tshogs rnams la bdag bstod do// zhes dang*/ bstod pa rgyas par dga' na gzhan ltar sbyar/ bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i dbus su so so'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten khams kyi mthu dang gzi brjid dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad bsdus shing rang la thim par bsam/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swā hā/ zhes srog snying ni gtso che bas mi myur mi dal sgra che ba dang chung ba ma yin/ gi gu/ na ro/ 'greng bu/ klad skor/ tshig zur rnams ma chag /mi smra mi yeng ba'i ngang nas myur bar rtse gcig tu spos sbyor sreg cing 'bum phrag bzhi bcu thems par bzlas na ji ltar bsam pa'i las 'grub par 'gyur ro// rtsa ba'i sngags/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bai shra ma ṇa ya ma hā rā dzā ya/ tad+ya thā/ si mi si mi/ su mu su mu/ tsan+dha tsan+dha/ tsa ra tsa ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ ki li ki li/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ san+dha ya/ āt+ma nāṃ/ nit+ya an+ta dha tu swā hā/ oṃ dha na dā na ye swā hā/ na mo ra tha pa ri pū ra ye swā hā/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas la/ rta bdag brgyad po so so'i thugs kar sngags rnams dmigs la/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la ye swā hā/ oṃ pūr+ṇa bha dra ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ye swā hā/ oṃ ku be ra ye swā hā/ oṃ saṃ pra dz+nyā na ye swā hā/ oṃ gu h+ya dha na ye swā hā/ oṃ pañci kā ye swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ye swā hā/

zhes gtso 'khor yongs sgril gyi sngags ring ni/ tad+ya thā/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra| ki li ma ni bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e h+ye hi tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha sarba ar+tha me swā hā/ tad+yathā/ su dha ni/ su+u ra se/ su ma ti/ su pu ṣe/ hi li mi li swā hā/ zhes pa'ang brgya rtsa brgyad yan chad re bzla'o// de ltar nyin thun drug tu bcad nas bzlas pa dang po/ gos sngon can grub pa'i rtags ni/ pha rol stobs chen gyi mis bdag la rdo rje ster ba/ gos sngon bkon pa dang*/ gzhan yang me tog 'thu ba dang*/ mkha' la 'phur ba dang*/ sbrul za ba/ rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ nyi zla za dang lag gis 'dzin/ gdan 'ding ba/ khang bzang du 'jug pa rnams bzang*/ gzhan gyis rang gi lag gi rdo rje 'phrog pa/ gos sngon bshu ba/ me tog 'thu ba sogs la gegs byed pa rnams ni bar chad kyi rtags so// gzhan yang ri dang mchod rten la 'dzeg pa/ nyi zla shar ba/ gcan gzan gtum po zhon pa/ lus las rnag khrag dang ngan skyug zag pa/ khrus byas pa/ mdun gyi sku gzugs dang mchod gtor las snyan pa'i sgra dang 'od byung ba/ dgra la 'thab pas rang rgyal ba sogs rtags bzang po mthong na spro ba bskyed gzengs bstod sgrub pa yun bsring ngo*// rgyal po chen po grub pa'i rtags ni/ mi chen chas bzang mang po 'du zhing rang la phyag 'tshal ba/ 'bru dang rin po che 'bul ba dang*/ rang gis rnyed pa dang*/ mang po'i dbus su khri bzang po'i steng na 'dug pa dang*/ gos rgyan bzang po sna tshogs lus la 'chang ba dang*/ 'bru dang nor gyi char bab pa/ nyi zla shar ba/ khang bzang gi nang du 'jug pa/ dmag dpon byas te rang rgyal ba/ gangs ri'i rtse la phyin pa/

sgrub khang du dri bzang po dang*/ 'od dang sgra snyan po byung ba sogs dngos nyams rmi lam gang la byung yang shin tu bzang*/ gos hrul po gyon pa/ sprang po mang du 'du zhing longs spyod 'phrog pa/ gos nag gyon pa/ khang stong du 'jug pa/ thur du kha bltas te 'gro ba/ g.yang la lhung ba/ mun nag tu 'jug pa/ gcig por thang stong du 'khyams pa/ yid ma bde zhing bsnyen sgrub mchod gtor la mi spro bar dngos nyams rmi lam gang la'ang ngan pas tshogs gsog pa dang*/ bskang bshags/ bsnyen sgrub mchod gtor/ sāts+tsha/ gsung sgrog /chu gtor sogs la 'bad cing mtshams dam par bya/ gtso bo 'di bsgrub pa la/ sgrub khang gi dben pa'i phyogs su gtor ma rgyan bzang po bza' bca' btung ba sna tshogs kyis bran pa byin kyis brlabs nas gta' ru btsud de lo gsar pa'i dus sngar bzhin cho ga la mkhas pas gsar du brje ba dang rgyun du mchod gtor 'bul ba dang*/ 'di'i dbang gi dus tshes de dang*/ gzhan yang dus bzang po la mchod gtor ci 'byor ba 'bul ba la brtson par bya'o// spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig bsrung ba gal che'o// de ltar sgrub pa'i ring thun mtshams rnams su gtor ma 'bul zhing bskang bshags bya ba ni rin po che'i snod gas chag med par gtor ma phyag len ltar bshams la/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa'i nang du gtor ma 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur pa'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum gsal ba'i/ oṃ las 'od zer dkar po byung gtor ma kha dog ngan pa'i nyes pa dag cing phun sum tshogs par byas/ āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros ro mi zhim pa sbyangs shing bzang por gyur/ hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros nus pa dman pa bsal zhing khyad par can du byas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/

yi ge gsum zhu gtor ma la thim pas zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i chen por gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs gsum gyis bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa na sarba sā dha naṃ swā hā| lan gsum gyis mgron rnams kyi bzhed pa 'grub cing gnod pa sel bar nus pa'i rdzas su gyur/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum gyis nam mkha' gang bar bsam/ oṃ gu ru tsa ra ṇa pa raṃ pa ra a kā ro sogs gsum gyis rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*/ oṃ nī laṃ wā ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs gsum gyis gos sngon can la 'bul/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya i daṃ ba ling gṛh+ṇan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha sarba karma pā ra a mo gha ya swā hā/ lan gsum gyis gtso bo dang rta bdag brgyad kyi sngags so sor i daṃ ba liṃ sogs btags pa dang*/ 'khor thams cad la a kā ros phul nas/ hūm̐ */ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras// 'khor bcas mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul ldan rnams la// gtor ma 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa kun// bu sdug bzhin du rtag tu skyong bar mdzod// bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus myur du mdzod/ bskang ba ni/ rin chen mang sprul rgyal po chen po ni// bde mdzad srid gsum rgud dang phongs pa las// myur skyob dpal 'bar bkra shis bde ster ba// mgon po dngos grub gter mchog thugs dam bskang*// gos sngon lung thang phreng ba cang shes rta// 'dod 'jo'i ba dang gter bum dpag bsam shing*// khrus kyi rdzing bu gtsug lag khang chen po// gsang chen bris sku dam pas thugs dam bskang*// don dam spros bral skye 'gag gnas gsum bral// rdo rje 'dzin dang rgyal po chen po dang*// ting 'dzin gzha' tshon lta bur dus kun spyod// lta spyod dgongs pa yang zab thugs dam bskang*// gsang sngags bsnyen sgrub thun mong khyad par dang*// sku gsung thugs dang bye brag spyi rnams kyi// dam tshig gtsang ma'i dge ba gang mchis pas| |mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*// gta' gtor rgyun gtor dus gtor gnyan po dang*// mchod pa lnga dang 'dod yon rnam pa lnga/

rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rdzas rnams kyis/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /nas 'bras gro sran til dang 'bru yi tshogs// dza ti gur kum ga pur tsan+dan dang*| |gla rtsi dri lnga 'bras bu lnga dang ni// byi dri sing dri ha si de ba dang*// kar+ṇi ka dang sman mchog rnam lnga dang*// chu yi snying po lan tshwa rtsi thog dang*// shing thog bu ram sbrang rtsi til mar dang*| |lus 'phags po dang 'dzam gling ba lang spyod// sgra mi snyan dang gling phran brgyad po dang*// ri rab nyi zla kun bzang mchod pas spras// mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*| |thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su bskangs gyur nas// bdag cag sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol// zhes bskang ba dang*/ bshags pa ni/ hūm̐ */ byang phyogs skyong ba gser ltar dwangs pa'i sku// dri med nyi zla lta bur 'od zer 'phro// sgrub mchog bskang phyir rgyal mtshan ne'u le 'dzin// bstan srung rgyal chen 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs// rgyal po khyod kyi sku gsung thugs dang ni// spang zhing blang ba'i dam tshig srung mtshams las// rnal 'byor le lo'i dbang gis 'da' srid na// bzod par bzhes te bu bzhin skyong bar mdzod// spang bar bya ba'i dam tshig las 'das pa// ro la 'jus shing ro gos gyon pa dang*// rta nag zhon zhing re nag bting ba dang*// zhwa nag gos nag gyon pa mthol lo bshags// rta bong sha khrag zos dang 'thung ba dang*| |yug mos byin pa'i kha zas zos pa dang*// gas chag snod du bza' btung bgyis pa sogs// rgyal chen khyod kyi sku la bzod par gsol// dang du blang ba'i dam tshig las 'das pa| |bsnyen pa ma thems gnad la bor ba dang*// sbyin pa ma btang 'dod chen nor blangs dang*// mchod gtor dus las 'das pa bzod par gsol// khyod sgrub rten rnams bcang bar dam bcas nas// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten gsum ma 'dzom dang*// rnyed kyang lus la ma 'chang bral ba dang*// lung thang phreng bar ma bsgrang bzod par gsol// mdor na chos skyong khyod kyi dam tshig las// 'gal zhing nyams par gyur pa ci mchis pa// gnod sbyin khyod la bzod par gsol lags kyi// tshangs par stsal nas sgrub mchog bskyang du gsol// zhes dang oṃ bai shra ma ṇa sa ma ya/

ma nu pā la ya sogs yig brgya brjod/ nub tha mar gtor skyong bya ba ni/ gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs nas/ hūm̐ */ ri rab byang gi phyogs na gnas mdzad pa// sku mdog ser po gser ltar rab brjid cing*// rgyal mtshan ne'u le 'dzin pa'i gnod sbyin dpal// snang ba dbang du sdud mdzad rgyal po che// nyi ma ltar 'bar khyod la bdag 'dud do// ri rab ltar mtho gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa// bu sdug bzhin du khyod kyi brtse bas skyongs// 'gal rkyen zhi zhing bsam don 'grub pa sogs// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// bdag la gnod par sems pa dang*// log par zhugs pa'i dgra dang bgegs// de yi phru ma gzhom pa dang*// gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul cher mnga' ba'i// gnod sbyin dbang po 'khor bcas kyis// bdag gi re 'dod ma lus pa// myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes bskul zhing gtor ma 'bul/ lhag chad bskang zhing bzod par gsol/ rten yod na ye shes pa de la bstim/ med na bai sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// byang phyogs gnas su gshegs nas kyang*| |slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ gser gyi mdog can nor bu'i mdzod// phongs pa las sgrol nyi ma'i rje// dbul ba'i nyes 'joms rgyal po che// nam mkha' mdzod kyi bkra shis shog /ces dang*/ shis brjod gzhan yang brjod/ gtor ma lhag ma dngos grub tu rol/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// tshul de lta bu ni phrin las rgyas pa yin la cung zad bsdus par 'dod na/

nang 'khor bskyed pa dor nas gtso bo'i rjes su/ phyi'i shar gyi khang brtsegs su zhes sogs sbyar zhing bzhugs pa'o// rjes su/ phyi'i 'khor sa dang por klu chen brgyad/ 'khor sa bar pa rim pa gnyis kyi nang ma la sde dpon nyer brgyad dang*/ phyi rim la stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis/ 'khor sa phyi ma la phyogs skyong*/ gza' skar/ lha klu dri za gnod sbyin sde brgyad kyi tshogs rnams dang*/ ljongs chen gnas pa bco lnga/ yul 'khor skyong ba lnga brgya/ 'khor gnod byin bye ba phrag du ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams/ cha lugs dang mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa log 'dren tshar gcod cing nor bu sna tshogs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pas sgrub pa po'i bsam pa yongs su tshim par byed pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings su char sprin dkrigs pa ltar bzhugs par gyur ces bsdus la sbyar/ gzhan thams cad dkyus ltar bya ba yin no// smras pa/ rdo rje sa 'og dngos grub 'byung ba dang*// sna tshogs grub dang gar mkhan mchog sogs kyi// rgyud nas slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po yis// lag na rdo rje rgyal po rnam thos sras// zhi ba bde byed sgrub pa'i thabs mdzad pa// sngon byon mkhas pa khungs thub rim byon gyis// mdzad rnams thos shing rtogs nas de dag gi// don bsdus ma tshang med pa tshig gi tshogs// 'tshams par bkod 'dir nor 'phrul dri med phyir// don gnyer rnams kyis mig ltar 'di zung zhig /deng sang 'di gzhung rgyas bsdus sna tshogs pa// brtsams chos mthong mod gsar rnying bsres pa'i steng*// rang bzo'i 'thad legs sbyar ba nyes brgya'i khur/ /phrag tu blangs pa rnams dang 'di mi mnyam// 'di dges sems can phongs pa kun zhi nas// rgyal ba'i go 'phang bsnyeg la bdag bsngo'o// zhes rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras ser po zhi ba bde byed sgrub cing mchod pa'i las rim zangs dkar gyi lugs su bkod pa dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/

rang nyid kyi nye gnas rim gro pa dge slong dan pa dkon mchog tshe ring gis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas me sprel rgyal gyi zla ba'i dkar po'i rdzogs pa dang po la pho brang rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ//
